comment.body: The description that Command Palette survives is useful, but the post-restart archive did not identify which process exited. Please update to the newest stable PowerToys release, reproduce the disappearance, then comment `/bugreport` immediately after noticing it before relaunching. Include the exact version/install channel and any matching Event Viewer Application Error entry so the runner, module, packaging, or external-termination path can be separated.
